description: A dataset for detecting diseased trees in forested areas using remote sensing, important in environmental monitoring.

variables.meaning: The column 'GLCM_Pan' contains data of type numerical. It represents the GLCM_Pan of the observation.
The column 'Mean_G' contains data of type numerical. It represents the Mean_G of the observation.
The column 'Mean_R' contains data of type numerical. It represents the Mean_R of the observation.
The column 'Mean_NIR' contains data of type numerical. It represents the Mean_NIR of the observation.
The column 'SD_Plan' contains data of type numerical. It represents the SD_Plan of the observation.
The column 'class' contains data of type categorical. It represents the class of the observation.
